title: Vehicle Bill of Sale
summary: Records the sale of a car, truck or motorcycle between two people.
useWhen: You are selling or buying a used vehicle privately.
watchOuts: Some states require a notarized bill of sale.

sections.title: Vehicle
sections.body: {{vehicle}}, VIN {{vin}}, with {{odometer}} miles on the odometer.

sections.title: Price and Payment
sections.body: {{seller_name}} sells the vehicle to {{buyer_name}} for {{price}}, paid in full on {{sale_date}}.

sections.title: Condition
sections.body:
The vehicle is sold {{condition}}. The seller states they own it free of liens.
